PUBLISHED PAPER • APRIL 2025

Comparative Analysis of Bracing System using STAAD.Pro Software

Authors: Mahesh Chiman Choudhary, Yash Baban Nale, Kundan Sunil Kumawat, Kiran Kerba Galande, Prof. Ankita Mali

The study evaluates seismic behavior of G+4 RCC framed structures using STAAD.Pro V8i and the Response Spectrum Method, comparing bracing configurations using structural response parameters.

IJIRSET • Vol. 14, Issue 4April 2025DOI 10.15680/IJIRSET.2025.1404266
